contracts.versions: Document 2/local checkpoint 1/default ABI 5/rich ABI 1 are unchanged. Original V1 shared factories remain model 11/journal 12. Explicit native V2 remains model 12/journal 13; no automatic migration, V2 Wasm/SDK/relay factory or new browser surface.
contracts.lowering: Each action admits the complete Rust core result, lowers to owned births/placements/deletion contributions and original text routes, then verifies the final AST against that core result. Earlier V1 and V2 preparation is unchanged; new structural infrastructure has a separate V2-only path.
contracts.tasks: Fresh wrapping requires explicit checked defaults. Split retains left completion, creates an unchecked right task and routes the original suffix/tail. Join preserves left completion and complete rich reading order; with a left rich tail it does not concatenate the right head ahead of that tail. Indent/outdent/empty exit retain actual flow parents, normalized heads, completion and source identities. Foreign text and checked contributions survive selective Undo. Concurrent placements have one visible winner and winner Undo can reveal another writer's placement.
contracts.quotesAndRules: Wrapping/unwrapping retains original bodies. A rule birth or replacement resolves owned placement at application time, after earlier commands may have moved flow. Sole-child rule deletion requires an explicit fresh semantic replacement. Final candidate limits do not require old and replacement subtrees to fit simultaneously.
contracts.codeSelection: Plain same-block UTF-16/scalar-aligned selected code replacement works in both directions with offline suffix edits and exact future history. Styled insertion and cross-code endpoints reject. This is not general cross-container selection or a code-exit policy.
contracts.originalModelIsolation: All fourteen V2 commands reject against original model 11 before target or value work, including deliberately invalid targets/values. Existing V1 journal operations and old V2 operations retain their meanings.
contracts.paste: Existing semantic PasteBlocks resolves only actual document, cell, ordinary-list-item, V2 quote or task-item flow parents. No foreign HTML/Office adapter is implied.

deterministicRepairs.reproduction: Wrap a new quote, insert a rule in it, then replace that rule with fresh flow in one authored group. Infrastructure birth ordering was prepared before preceding commands moved children, so final AST verification failed.
deterministicRepairs.repair: Insert/replacement adds its owned placement at actual semantic application time, with a bounded-order-disjoint fixed ordinal that is identical on native and Wasm. No identity or text copying.

deterministicRepairs.reproduction: The pinned undo engine compares wall-clock delta < merge interval. Interval zero still merges distinct groups when time decreases. In real older Wasm, two dispatches become one live Undo step; normal-clock restoration rebuilds two. Saving after that merged Undo reliably rejects recovery with journal replay differs from the saved operation identities/effects.
deterministicRepairs.repair: Breditor sets the private engine time interval to i64::MIN, disabling that branch while retaining explicit group_start/group_end coalescing within one authored multi-command edit. No vendor source, OS time, user-browser settings or wire format is changed.
deterministicRepairs.proof: Normal, frozen and backward Date.now in an isolated Node process each retain one two-command batch, two separate dispatches, both Undo and Redo steps, recovery before Undo and recovery from a checkpoint saved after Undo. The SDK packaging check runs the real rebuilt-Wasm assertion in a child process before packing.
deterministicRepairs.limit: This identifies the controlled clock failure, not the earlier unrecorded native code/style invocation or historical intermittent WebKit fault.
